hardImpact.title: When every minute costs millions.
hardImpact.content: The platform prevents line stops with early risk detection, orchestrates escalation across multi-brand OEM programs, and keeps audit-ready IATF 16949 evidence in place.

indicators.detail: Line-stop risk is active and escalation starts immediately.
Part-level monitoring flags deviations before cascading impact.
Audit trail is complete and retrieval-ready.

fieldReports.title: Anonymized Field Reports
fieldReports.principle: The focus is not who caused the issue, but how Flow Agent prevents systemic supply-chain risk before impact scales.

cases.title: CASE 1
cases.body: A major US-based OEM program involving plastic versus metal components in a steering assembly placed about 10,000 vehicles on hold. Flow Agent surfaces the deviation early, drives escalation management, and protects launch stability.

cases.title: CASE 2
cases.body: A quality crisis in a global driveline platform involved electronic components and material deviations. Flow Agent links part-level monitoring, early warnings, and audit-ready documentation for time-critical decisions.
